development.net_gain_definition: candidate resolved minus baseline resolved = gains - regressions on the unchanged native grader
development.controls: Fresh24 trusted actual unpatched/reference controls; exact plan/archive/task/snapshot/image/SDK/compiled-native contracts; full output/patch/JUnit/import provenance/trace; clean containers
development.source_only: All source patches inspected for intended implementation only; no test/harness/reproduction files/features in submitted patch or ZIP
development.consumer_observation: Observed failure of issue-specific consumer-visible check before edit, same exact check success afterward; require raw command/trace/output references and exact check/scratch body identity. Count unique checks and complying tasks per arm; never assume prompt adherence from code/text searches

prospective_confirmation.development_admission: Hash-approved full12 development summary with at least2 gains/zero regressions; source-only review and exact raw consumer check approval covering every candidate gain. Main CPU driver still requires24 development controls and native consumer smoke.
prospective_confirmation.selection: Freeze deterministic IDs/order and exposure-audit provenance before any inference, without gold or issue-body selection; no replacement of failed cases
prospective_confirmation.condition: Only after development meets ≥2 net gains/zero regressions/source-only/observed consumer gates
prospective_confirmation.admission: Fresh2N trusted controls of same native SDK/sampling/budgets/grader/image and hash binding before confirmation task inference
prospective_confirmation.completeness: Complete paired confirmation and full raw evidence; zero regressions; no upload recommendation while unperformed or partial
prospective_confirmation.time: Complete planned cohort must fit remaining single allocation worst-case session + setup/grading/retrieval window; otherwise explicitly requires a separately authorized future confirmation experiment, never extra GPU restart here

backend.mandatory: Full hashed live version/models/config/structured64K config/both raw alias wire requests+responses/tokenize delimiters/actual16-token budget probe and observation; enabled4096 thinking, historyTrue, real SDK compiler

attribution_limits: One stochastic sample per task/arm; exposed development, not fresh held out
Single-A100 text-only64K controlled experiment is not scorer parity
Prompt-only archive delta isolates instruction change; consumer compliance still requires raw evidence adjudication
Successful salvage patch is distinguished from normal agent completion
SDK native consumer smoke certifies harness/tool execution only, not model policy compliance
No upload authorization or automated promotion decision
fail_closed: Any missing/untrusted/skipped required tests, non-snapshot imports, wrong reference/unpatched outcomes or cleanup failure blocks inference
Any missing/changed CPU admission/control/backend artifact hashes blocks inference
Any incomplete development pair or regression blocks promotion
Source-only or observed-consumer gate unmet blocks promotion
Prospective confirmation unmet blocks upload recommendation
